highlights.reason_zh: Strands Decider 的开放权重与完整实验材料让 agent 路由可以独立复现。
highlights.reason_en: Strands Decider's open weights and complete experiment artifacts make agent routing independently reproducible.

highlights.reason_zh: MAI Speech 把低延迟转写、语音合成、价格与调用入口同时公开。
highlights.reason_en: MAI Speech exposes low-latency transcription, synthesis, pricing and access paths together.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 2.1.288 直接修复 MCP 重复执行与默认拒绝边界。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code 2.1.288 directly fixes duplicate MCP execution and fail-closed boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: MCP SDK 2.3 的安全默认值伴随明确的 transport 兼容风险。
highlights.reason_en: MCP SDK 2.3's safer defaults come with explicit transport compatibility risk.

highlights.reason_zh: Kolibri 为德语企业 RAG 与工具调用提供了可检查的开放权重。
highlights.reason_en: Kolibri provides inspectable open weights for German enterprise RAG and tool calling.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；另核查官方发布、模型卡、代码仓库与论文。两个到期项目复核及其逾期 7 日任务均已完成。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read, supplemented by official releases, model cards, repositories and papers. Both due project reviews and their overdue seven-day tasks were completed.
